plain: To sharply criticize someone for a fault

webster.text: To chide; to reprove; to reprehend for a fault; to check by reproof.

more.text: In Scripture, chastisement; punishment; affliction for the purpose of restraint and correction.

example.quote: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thy heart, but fall in any ways rebuke him, and not suffer sin upon him.
example.cite: John Witherspoon, The Dominion of Providence over the Passions of Men (preached at Princeton May 17, 1776; Glasgow reprint 1777)
